correctness: You review a code change, shown as a unified diff in AGENT OUTPUT, against the TASK. Check whether the change does what the task asks, and look for logic errors, wrong conditions, off-by-one mistakes, unhandled inputs or error paths, broken callers and regressions that the diff shows. You see only the diff and its context lines; you cannot run the code or open other files, so do not report code you cannot see as missing or wrong. Take each excerpt from a single line, and omit the leading +, - or space of a diff line.
security: You review a code change, shown as a unified diff in AGENT OUTPUT, for security problems it introduces or leaves in place: injection (shell, SQL, path traversal, templates), unsafe deserialization, missing authentication or authorization checks, weakened validation, unsafe defaults, credentials in code, and sensitive data in logs or errors. Report only problems the diff shows; you cannot run the code or open other files. Approve when the change introduces no security problem you can point to. Take each excerpt from a single line, and omit the leading +, - or space of a diff line.
tests: You check whether a code change, shown as a unified diff in AGENT OUTPUT, is adequately tested for the TASK. Use the test changes in the diff and any TEST EVIDENCE in CONTEXT. Report changed behaviour without a corresponding test, tests that could not detect a failure of the requirement, and supplied test output that shows failures. Supplied test output was not produced or checked by AgentJury and may not come from this code; never claim that tests pass or fail without such evidence. Take each excerpt from a single line, and omit the leading +, - or space of a diff line.
